name: Cryptococcus gattii species complex
aliases: C. gattii / C. deuterogattii and related molecular types

syndromes.title: CNS / disseminated disease
rows: Usually at least 2 weeks; in non-HIV C. gattii CNS infection, consider extending induction to 4–6 weeks.
CNS/disseminated disease; 4–6 week induction consideration specifically applies to non-HIV C. gattii CNS infection
Chang 2024 Cryptococcosis | Fig 1 / pulmonary-distributed syndrome tables | PDF p2 + Supplement sTable 6
Reassess response and step-down per syndrome-specific guideline
Use CNS cryptococcosis induction principles. The guideline specifically advises considering 4–6 weeks of induction for non-HIV C. gattii CNS infection.

syndromes.title: Pulmonary cryptococcoma
rows: Only applies to selected completely excised asymptomatic disease.
Consider 4–6 weeks if multiple and any lesion ≥2 cm; otherwise source table often uses 2-week induction
BIIu for 4–6-week consideration in large/multiple lesions
Severity and lesion size determine the branch.

syndromes.title: C. gattii CNS disease / cryptococcoma — special considerations
rows: CNS regimen as for cryptococcal meningitis
Consider 4–6 weeks in non-HIV C. gattii CNS infection
Chang 2024 Cryptococcosis Suppl | sTable 5 / C. gattii sections | pS21 onward
Longer induction is a consideration, not a universal mandate.
